translationRepairs: 列傳第六 is a chapter heading, not a year.
Taking command, he forced the march day and night while letting it be known he was sailing for Liu Yi's province.
Taking command, he forced the march day and night while spreading word that Liu of Yanzhou (Liu Fan) was coming upriver.
劉兗州 is Liu Fan, Inspector of Yanzhou, not Liu Yi.
On the northern expedition he served as Pacifying West adviser, acting Dragon Valor general, and vanguard commander.
On the northern expedition he served as consultant to the Garrisoning the West general, acting Dragon Valor general, and vanguard commander.
鎮西 is Garrisoning the West, distinct from 安西.
He demurred: "This is your majesty's authority and the generals' labor."
He demurred: "This is Your Excellency's authority and the generals' labor."
明公 addresses Liu Yu as a minister, not as emperor.
At Bashang he welcomed the Emperor, who told him, "You have made my empire real."
At Bashang he welcomed the Emperor, who told him, "It is truly you who have completed my hegemonic enterprise."
成吾霸業 means completing his hegemonic enterprise.

His Huainan uncle Jiang was a mediocrity. Lingshi made him lie in the hall, stuck a square of paper on his pillow, and from eight or nine feet away threw a knife suspended on a string—a hundred throws, a hundred hits.

His Huainan uncle Jiang was a mediocrity. Lingshi made him lie in the hall, stuck a square of paper on his pillow, and from eight or nine feet away threw a knife at it—a hundred throws, a hundred hits.
縣擲 means throwing from a distance, not a knife on a string.
He was made Pacifying Army adjutant, then magistrate of Wukang.
He was made adjutant on the Garrisoning Army general's staff, then magistrate of Wukang.
鎮軍 is Garrisoning Army, not Pacifying.
Critics said he was too young and unknown to succeed. The Emperor ignored them.
Critics said he was still too light in rank and reputation to succeed. The Emperor ignored them.
資名尚輕 refers to rank and reputation, not age.
the fourteenth year of In, when Duke of Guiyang Yizhen was recalled, Lingshi became Governor of Yong with command over all Guanzhong forces.
In the fourteenth year (of Yixi), when Duke of Guiyang Yizhen was recalled, Lingshi became Governor of Yong with command over all Guanzhong forces.
In the twelfth year of Yixi northern campaign Chaoshi led the vanguard into the Yellow River.
In the northern campaign of the twelfth year of Yixi, Chaoshi led the vanguard into the Yellow River.
Emperor Wu made him Pacifying Army adviser, then General of the Right Guard.
Emperor Wu made him consultant to the Garrisoning Army general, then General of the Right Guard.
鎮軍 is Garrisoning Army; 諮議 is a consultant.
When Qiao Zong killed his father Jin, the Emperor made Xiuzhi Dragon Valor general, gave him troops, and sent him west at once.
When Qiao Zong killed his father Jin, the Emperor made Xiuzhi Dragon-Prancing General, gave him troops, and sent him west at once.

He once served mutton soup to a Wei minister who found it exquisite and sent it to Taiwu. Delighted, the emperor made him Director of the Imperial Kitchen, then Minister, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Marquis of Nan—keeping both kitchen and ministerial posts.

He once served mutton soup to a Wei minister who found it exquisite and sent it to Taiwu. Delighted, the emperor made him Director of the Imperial Kitchen, then Minister, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Duke of Nan commandery—keeping both kitchen and ministerial posts.
南郡公 is a duke, not a marquis.
Mao Xiuzhi laughed. "When I left the south Yin was a boy. The day I crawl home in shame I'll show up at his gate with bridle in hand."
Mao Xiuzhi laughed. "When I left the south Yin was a boy. The day I crawl home in shame I'll show up at his gate in a servant's headcloth and arm-guards."
巾韝 is a servant's headcloth and sleeve-guards.
His grandson Huisu served Qi as Director of the Palace Parks.
His grandson Huisu served Qi as Chamberlain for the Palace Revenues.
少府卿 is the Chamberlain for the Palace Revenues.
He died leaving only bare walls. The empress later learned he was innocent and was deeply remorseful.
He died leaving only bare walls. Emperor Wu later learned he was innocent and was deeply remorseful.
武帝后 means Emperor Wu later (后=後), not the empress.
In Jin the third year of Taikang Lingzhou was restored and the Fu clan was re-registered there.
In the third year of Taikang under Emperor Wu of Jin, Lingzhou was restored and the Fu clan was re-registered there.
Hongzhi's great-grandfather Di had been Jin Minister Over the Masses and was later enfeoffed Duke of Lingzhou.
Hongzhi's great-great-grandfather Di had been Jin Minister Over the Masses and was later enfeoffed Duke of Lingzhou.
His great-grandfather Chang, a Secretariat Director, was captured by Shi Le and fathered Hong.
His great-grandfather Chang, Assistant of the Palace Library, was captured by Shi Le and fathered Hong.
秘書丞 is Assistant of the Palace Library.
On the northern expedition Hongzhi entered through Wuguan with Shen Tianzi of Fufeng and seven columns.
On the northern expedition Hongzhi entered through Wuguan with Shen Tianzi, Administrator of Fufeng, and seven columns.
扶風太守 is an office.
Xiuzhi began as a provincial chief clerk and in the Yuanjia era rose to Attendant Gentleman of the Ministry of Works.
Xiuzhi began as a provincial chief clerk and in the Yuanjia era rose to Attendant Gentleman on the staff of the Minister over the Masses.
司徒 is Minister over the Masses.
Emperor Wen told him, "Your great-grandfather served Wang Dao as the chancellor's chief clerk; you now serve Wang Hong in the same post. You honor your line."
Emperor Wen told him, "Your great-grandfather served Wang Dao as Gentleman of the Interior on the chancellor's staff; you now serve Wang Hong in the same post. You honor your line."
中郎 is Gentleman of the Interior, not chief clerk.
Wei was hammering Huanglong. Feng Hong sent envoys begging aid. Xiuzhi had the Song messenger talk them into leaving.
Wei was hammering Huanglong. Feng Hong sent envoys begging aid. Xiuzhi had the Song envoy persuade Feng Hong to send him home.
說而遣之: persuade Feng Hong to send him off.
On return he was made Palace Attendant.
On return he was made Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
黃門侍郎 is Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
At Jiankang his ox bolted and broke his leg. He resigned the ministry for Grand Master of Chongxian, with special advancement and the gold seal and purple ribbon.

At Jiankang his ox bolted and broke his leg. He resigned the ministry to become Chamberlain for the Chongxian Palace, and was given Specially Advanced status and the rank of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon.
崇憲太僕 is a chamberlain post; 金紫光祿大夫 is a rank.
Six generations back, Hong was Administrator of Hedong and Marquis of Mianzhu. Following his uncle Minister Xu into exile he abandoned office, moved north to Xinxing, and governed Xinxing and Yanmen.

Six generations back, Hong was Administrator of Hedong and Marquis of Mianzhu. Following his father's cousin, Minister over the Masses Wang Yun, into exile he abandoned office, moved north to Xinxing, and governed Xinxing and Yanmen.
司徒允 is Wang Yun; 從叔 is a father's cousin.
In Yuanjia he became Pacifying Army staff major to Prince of Changsha Yixin and Administrator of Runan.
In Yuanjia he became adjutant of the central troops to the Garrisoning Army general, Prince of Changsha Yixin, and concurrently Administrator of Ruyin.
鎮軍中兵參軍; 汝陰 is Ruyin, not Runan.
He later served as Pacifying State staff major to Marquis of Xing'an Yibin and Administrator of Pengcheng.
He later served as staff major to the Bulwark of State general to Marquis of Xing'an Yibin and Administrator of Pengcheng.
輔國 is Bulwark of State.
The vanguard entered the Yellow River under Pacifying State General Xiao Bin.
The vanguard entered the Yellow River under Bulwark of State General Xiao Bin.
輔國將軍 is Bulwark of State General.
Xiao Bin meant to execute him. Shen Qingzhi protested firmly: "Bili's power shakes the world. A million bows answer his call—Xuanmo was never meant to stand alone against that.
Xiao Bin meant to execute him. Shen Qingzhi protested firmly: "Foli's power shakes the world. A million bows answer his call—Xuanmo was never meant to stand alone against that.
佛狸 is Foli, Taiwu's childhood name.
In the first month of year 28 he returned to Licheng.
In the first month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia he returned to Licheng.
When Yixuan and Zang Zhi of Jiangzhou rebelled, the court made Xuanmo acting Pacifying State General, southern vanguard, and Governor of Yu.
When Yixuan and Zang Zhi of Jiangzhou rebelled, the court made Xuanmo acting Bulwark of State General, southern vanguard, and Governor of Yu.
輔國將軍 is Bulwark of State General.
Knowing the charge was false, the emperor sent Chief Secretary Wu Xigong to reassure him.
Knowing the charge was false, the emperor sent Chief Secretary Wu Xi to reassure him publicly.
吳喜 is the name; 公 means publicly.
He later became Grand Master of the Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon and Director of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
He later became Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Gold Seal and Purple Ribbon, concurrently Chamberlain for Ceremonials.
金紫光祿大夫 and 太常.
Palace Attendant Zong Lingxiu was corpulent and bowed with difficulty. At every feast Xiaowu piled gifts on him hoping he would rise, stumble, and amuse the court.
Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Zong Lingxiu was corpulent and bowed with difficulty. At every feast Xiaowu piled gifts on him hoping he would rise, stumble, and amuse the court.
黃門侍郎 is Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
He carved a wooden statue of Lingxiu's father Shuxian and sent it to the family hall.
He carved a wooden statue of Lingxiu's father, Superintendent of the Palace Shuxian, and sent it to the family hall.
After Shaodi murdered Yan Shibo and Liu Yuanjing his madness worsened. He summoned Xuanmo with the Palace Guard. Kin urged him to plead illness.
After Shaodi murdered Yan Shibo and Liu Yuanjing his madness worsened. He summoned Xuanmo to be General Leading the Army. Kin urged him to plead illness.
以領軍征 means summoned as General Leading the Army.
He was then made Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand General with Three Dukes ceremony, Director of the Palace Guard, and Governor of South Yu with full command.

He was then made Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, granted a Separate Office with Ceremonial Equal to the Three Dukes, concurrently General Protecting the Army, and Governor of South Yu with full command.
開府儀同三司 and 護軍將軍.
Zishen died young, and his son Hui inherited the line.
His son Shen died young, and Shen's son Hui inherited the line.
子深 means his son Shen, not a name Zishen.
His mother had been captured by rebels in the west. He asked leave to go west, stormed Suide, and brought her back.
His mother had been captured by rebels in the west. He asked leave to go west, stormed Sui commandery, and brought her back.
In the first Qi Yongming year he became Grand Master of Ceremonies, but was dismissed for slaughtering an ox at home.
In the first year of Yongming under Qi he became Chamberlain for Ceremonials, but was dismissed for slaughtering an ox at home.
Garbled date; 太常 is Chamberlain for Ceremonials.
Visiting Liu Yanjie he climbed straight onto the couch. "You are a duke's son, I a marquis's son—let us drink knee to knee, just the two of us."
Visiting Liu Yanjie he climbed straight onto the couch. "You, my lord, are a duke's grandson; I am a duke's son—let us drink knee to knee, just the two of us."
公孫 is a duke's grandson; 公子 a duke's son.
Prince of Yuzhang of Qi had been Zhan's friend since youth.
Xiao Yi, Prince of Yuzhang of Qi, had been Zhan's friend since youth.
The prince 嶷 (Xiao Yi) was left unnamed.
Zhan often debated with Niao while Qi Wudi slept on the great bed. Zhan told Niao, "Even the man in the tent sleeps and wakes like anyone else."
Zhan often debated with Yi while Qi Wudi slept on the great bed. Zhan told Yi, "Even the man in the tent sleeps and wakes like anyone else."
嶷 is read Yi, not Niao.
Mid-conversation Niao asked whether Wang Kai was wiser than Yin Daojin. Zhan snapped, "Must you talk about someone else's brother?"
Mid-conversation Yi asked whether Wang Jingwen's elder brother Kai was wiser than Yin Daojin. Zhan snapped, "Must you talk about someone else's brother?"
嶷 is Yi; 王景文兄楷 omitted.
The emperor laughed and called Niao by his childhood name A'yu. "Your brother is a fool—how did Staff Officer Wang's line come from him?"
The emperor laughed and called Yi by his childhood name A'yu. "Your brother is a fool—how did Staff Officer Wang's line come from him?"
嶷 is read Yi, not Niao.
He later served as Palace Attendant.
He later served as Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
黃門侍郎 is Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
Inside lay a woman of about twenty, beautiful as if alive. She spoke from the coffin: "I am a daughter of the Wang house of Donghai, not yet born. Take the treasure—do not harm me."
Inside lay a woman of about twenty, beautiful as if alive. She spoke from the coffin: "I am a daughter of the Wang house of Donghai, and I am due to return to life. Take the treasure—do not harm me."
應生 means due to revive, not unborn.
When Qi Wudi garrisoned Huaiyin, Song's Emperor Ming suspected him. He turned north to Wei and wrote to win Xuanmiao over.
When Emperor Gao of Qi garrisoned Huaiyin, Song's Emperor Ming suspected him. He turned north to Wei and wrote to win Xuanmiao over.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
He still sent Shuan to Jiankang to expose Qi Wudi's plot.
He still sent Shuan to Jiankang to expose Emperor Gao's plot.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
Qi Wudi seized him on the road and demanded Xuanmiao's letter.
Emperor Gao seized him on the road and demanded Xuanmiao's letter.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
Xun Boyu urged execution. Qi Wudi said, "Each man serves his own lord—no blame in that."
Xun Boyu urged execution. Emperor Gao said, "Each man serves his own lord—no blame in that."
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
Xuanmiao left office and returned home. Qi Wudi ambushed him on the road. Xuanmiao marched his guard straight through.
Xuanmiao left office and returned home. Emperor Gao ambushed him on the road. Xuanmiao marched his guard straight through.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
Back at court he reported Qi Wudi's treachery to Song Mingdi. Qi Wudi bore no grudge.
Back at court he reported Emperor Gao's treachery to Song Mingdi. Emperor Gao bore no grudge.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
In the Shengming era Qi Wudi made him Rapid Cavalry staff major and Administrator of Taishan.
In the Shengming era Emperor Gao made him Rapid Cavalry staff major and Administrator of Taishan.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
Xuanmiao was terrified. Qi Wudi treated him as before.
Xuanmiao was terrified. Emperor Gao treated him as before.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
Qi Wudi heard it and said, "Xuanmiao has not failed me after all."
Emperor Gao heard it and said, "Xuanmiao has not failed me after all."
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
When Shen Youzhi rebelled, Xuanzai rose in loyalty, submitted to Qi Wudi, and was enfeoffed as Viscount of E county.
When Shen Youzhi rebelled, Xuanzai rose in loyalty, submitted to Emperor Gao of Qi, and was enfeoffed as Viscount of E county.
高帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
In the first Yanxing year he became General of the Central Guard.
In the first year of Yanxing he became General of the Central Guard.
Garbled era-year phrasing for 延興元年.
During the Jianwu era he died as Palace Guard commander and was posthumously made Governor of Yong with the title Marquis Zhuang.
During the Jianwu era he died in office as General Protecting the Army and was posthumously made Governor of Yong with the title Marquis Zhuang.
護軍 is General Protecting the Army.
When Qi Wudi took the throne he valued Fang Shuan's loyalty. Shuan was then Sima of Yi Province and Administrator of Ningshu, and was promptly made Forward General.
When Emperor Gao took the throne he valued Fang Shuan's loyalty. Shuan was then Sima of Yi Province and Administrator of Ningshu, and was promptly made Forward General.
髙帝 is Emperor Gao (Xiao Daocheng), not Qi Wudi.
